2. Actual electrochemically regulated adhesion construction and source limits

ROOT completed local identity/alias/hold checks before each new primary navigation. Initial Choi etal2025, High-Performance Electrochemical Adhesives Enabled by Perfluorinated Sulfonic-Acid Ionomers with Precise Adhesion Control and Long-Term Switchability, DOI10.1002/advs.202510512, exact https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12622435/ main throughline177 supplies an actual PFSA ionomer/Au50nm/Cu-foil interface with PET132um backing. Positive Cu-side current promotes the interfacial coordination state; reversing bias weakens attachment. The read main lap-shear experiment used1cm2 and.1mA for0--90s: force1.10N at0s and4.81N at60s; raising current from.1 to.3mA at60s increased force4.1 to8.4N, with less than1C heating. At charge3,6,12mC/cm2 the read estimated fracture-energy points were1.07+/-.06,2.02+/-.12,3.92+/-.24J/m2. Their geometry/compliance is indispensable.

The main relation F_c=sqrt(2*G_c*A/C_total) explicitly depends on specimen compliance. Reported high lap-shear stress is not a universal normal-strength or mode-I law. The initial author-summary statements about50cycles, two-month retention and a separate high-strength/compliance-controlled clutch case do not supply jointly qualified normal load, dimensions, film preparation, humidity or500-cycle life. The read initial XPS preparation used much greater327mC/cm2 than the6mC/cm2 mechanical example; its chemical-state observation is not a closed material inventory for every operational cycle.
